items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: Well, it was a good respect, Tim, because Buddy was a great, great man, a great trumpet player. In fact, I wish I could play what he did.

ctx.x: That's what he's speaking to his age against America. That's when Louie was in trouble, he said, if I've ever been gone, he was in the same town. Buddy died and Louie was a problem. And he was a problem.

Well, it was a good respect, Tim, because Buddy was a great, great man, a great trumpet player. In fact, I wish I could play what he did. That's a heartbreaking start. I've heard he died and I'm looking kind of worried. Yeah, there's quite a number of stories to it. But he was a sick man. Did they ever give any loving cups or any kind of stuff or number?
Not that I remember, but I got a loving cup here. And I don't know what ever happened. It was stolen from the U.S. And the U.S. And the U.S.
